symptoms: In routine practice, macular degeneration, also known as age-related macular degeneration, is an eye disease that gradually damages the macula...
In routine practice, it mainly affects older adults and can make tasks like reading, driving, recognizing faces, or seeing fine details difficult.
From a clinical perspective, wet ARMD is when abnormal blood vessels grow under the macula and leak fluid or blood, damaging the retina and causing rapid loss of central vision.
